# dead_code_floor.txt — the unreachable fns DEFINED UNDER src/ that each compiler fork carries.
# Read by tests/gates/codegen/dead_code_floor.sh; regenerate with its --write and REVIEW the diff.
# One line per fn: NAME FORK... — x86 = cycc (main.cyr), a64 = cycc_aarch64 cross
# (main_aarch64.cyr), cx = cyrius-x (main_cx.cyr), win = PE32+ (main_win.cyr), x86m = x86-macOS
# (main_x86_macho.cyr), a64n = aarch64-native (main_aarch64_native.cyr), a64m = arm64-macOS
# (main_aarch64_macho.cyr). Each is live in another fork that compiles the same file (IR
# passes only the x86 backend drives, PE- or Mach-O-only emitters, ...) — except TS_PEEKLINE,
# which tests/tcyr/frontend/ts_lex_combined.tcyr calls.
# ⚠ 6.7.7 B6 — TRANSIENT, in every fork: _pl_next, _pl_tdepth, _pl_has_dflt, _pd_named_at are
# the parameter / argument walkers bite 1b writes ahead of their callers (bite 2's definition
# record, bite 3's `_pd_call_fills`, bite 4's named-argument veto). Each line FAILS this gate the
# moment its fn goes live, so the bite that calls it deletes it; none may survive the B6 lane.
# (`_arg_next` / `_pd_label_at` went live at B4 T4: the tuple literal's element walker,
# `_tup_item_end`.)
